question: Which method gives the best three tags per memory, and does choosing from both sections (preferences and patterns) help?
decision: Which method OMMS uses to tag memories, and whether it may pick labels from either section.
approval: Operator asked on 2026-10-12 to plan Experiment 23 after Experiment 22, chose Standard, then asked to include cosine, reranker and the combination. Running needs separate approval.

H1.statement: Pooled hit@3 (multi-label key, 561 observations with a valid label): Clef both sections minus Clef one section >= 0.10, exact McNemar p < 0.05.

H2.statement: On observations with a valid label in their own section, Clef both-section hit@3 >= Clef one-section hit@3 minus 0.03.

H3.statement: Both sections: Clef against cosine, reranker and combination on hit@3; three exact McNemar tests, Holm-corrected, alpha 0.05.

hypotheses.H0: H1: gain < 0.10 or p >= 0.05. H3: no method differs from Clef after correction.

sections.H1_only: report the trade-off; the operator decides

decision_rule.method: Highest hit@3 in the chosen section setting; a cheaper method within 0.03 of it wins. Cost order: cosine, reranker, Clef, combination.

stats.test: exact McNemar (two-sided sign test on discordant pairs, Experiment 18 sign_test); Holm correction for H3
stats.note: No shared bootstrap helper exists; differences are reported with discordant counts.

gates.G1_integrity: all pinned inputs and model files match before and after
gates.G2_baseline_match: every rebuilt one-section request (Clef 600, reranker 400) matches its saved request_sha256
gates.G3_fit: every both-section Clef request <= 8192 input tokens
gates.G4_completeness: every arm has 600 valid answers; errors count as misses

arms.tags: three labels, none_fit never a tag, no cut-off
arms.cosine: Experiment 18 first_labels over the ranked gallery shortlist (10)
arms.reranker: top three label definitions by Experiment 17 order_by
arms.combination: round robin of ranks: Clef, cosine, reranker at rank 1, then rank 2, then rank 3; duplicates skipped; first three kept

sets.exp20: 200 observations, catalogue version 2 (56 labels); saved one-section Clef in Experiment 20 output/raw.json
